-export function build(g) {}
+// Part "chimneys" (parts/chimneys.mjs): three 2x2 brick stacks from y 6 to y 33 on their own footings, each with a trim band
+// at y 30 and a slab cap ring at y 33 stepping out one. W and E carry a hay_block signal base and a lit signal campfire in
+// the flue (smoke rises from the mouth); C is capped with no fire. Coordinates are plan.md CHIMNEYS (footprint x0,z0..x1,z1).
+// Writes go into air only (the roof part keeps the stack cells, so the stacks pass through the roof).
+import { chimney, CHIMNEYS, CAMPFIRE } from "../vocab.mjs";
+export function build(g) {
+  // W and E: smoke from the mouth. The flue is the cell (x1, z1) of the footing.
+  for (const key of ["W", "E"]) {
+    const c = CHIMNEYS[key];
+    chimney(g, c.x0, c.z0, { fire: true });
+    // The helper's campfire has no signal_fire state; a structure file keeps the state written, so set it here.
+    g.set(c.x1, 33, c.z1, CAMPFIRE, { facing: "north", lit: "true", signal_fire: "true" });
+  // C: rear breast in the yard, capped, no fire.
+  const c = CHIMNEYS.C;
+  chimney(g, c.x0, c.z0, { fire: false });

elements.md:5:- [ ] **Two tenant shop units (redstone sockets)**: x 4..12 and 12..20, y 7..12. Shell leaves socket boxes, wall lines and keep-clear (x 4..20 y 7..9 z 19..20) empty; runParts lays the fit-out. Part: shell (leaves), shopfronts. Vocab: `shopfront`. Run `$MCD sockets check`.
elements.md:6:- [ ] **Shopfront fascia per shop**: `dark_prismarine` board x 5..11 and 13..19, y 10..12, z 19 flush. Shop names as `plaque(g,"NAME",{material:null})` banner letters (white on teal), 3-row band. Part: shopfronts. Vocab: `fascia`.
elements.md:7:- [ ] **Consoles / pilasters framing each shop**: smooth_sandstone at x 4, 12, 20 y 10..12 z 19 plus console head z 20 y 11..12 (upside-down smooth_sandstone_stairs under a smooth_sandstone_slab top); end pilasters x 3 and 21, y 6..12, z 19..20, polished_andesite plinth y 6. Part: shopfronts. Vocab: `console`, `pilaster`.
elements.md:8:- [ ] **Hanging sign per shop**: x 4 and x 20, z 21, y 10: `dark_oak_fence` arm at y 11 z 20..21, `dark_oak_hanging_sign` (attached true, text = shop name) at y 10 z 21. Part: shopfronts. Vocab: `hangingSign`.
elements.md:9:- [ ] **Shop cornice**: y 13 x 3..26 z 20, smooth_sandstone_stairs upside-down facing north. Part: shopfronts. Vocab: `cornice`.
elements.md:10:- [ ] **Two storeys of flats**: brick walls y 13..22, floors at y 13 and 18 (planks floors in rooms), corridor and 4 flats (1W,1E,2W,2E). Part: shell. Vocab: `brickWall`.
elements.md:11:- [ ] **Flat windows**: 1x3 sash at x 5,11,13,19, y 15..17 and 19..21, z 19: glass_pane, sill slab y 14 / string course, trim lintel y 22. Part: windows. Vocab: `sashWindow`.
elements.md:12:- [ ] **Two oriel bays**: x 6..10 and 14..18, z 20, y 13..23: corbel y 13 (cornice), apron y 14, panel y 18, head y 22, corner posts, glass_pane x 7..9 at y 15..17 and 19..21, slab cap y 23; wall behind OPEN. Part: windows. Vocab: `oriel`.
elements.md:13:- [ ] **Flats' street door**: x 23..24 y 7..8 z 19, double dark_oak_door facing south, fanlight glass_pane y 9, trim surround x 22 and 25, hood smooth_sandstone_slab (bottom) y 10 z 20 on two console stairs, "FLATS" signboard x 23..24 y 11. Part: windows. Vocab: `streetDoor`, `signboard`.
elements.md:14:- [ ] **Stair bay with two flights**: x 22..23, flight 1 steps y 7..12 z 15..10, flight 2 y 14..17 z 15..12; wells open as plan. oak_stairs facing north, rail dark_oak_fence. Part: shell. Vocab: `flight`.
elements.md:15:- [ ] **Mansard roof with dormers**: deepslate_tiles, one rect x 3..26 z 2..19, y 24; dormers x 7..9, 15..17, 23..24; iron_bars crest. Part: roof (roof.json preset townhouse, keep = 3 chimneys).
elements.md:16:- [ ] **Eaves cornice**: y 23 x 3..26 z 19 band + z 20 upside-down stairs; rear z 1. Part: shell/shopfronts. Vocab: `cornice`.
elements.md:17:- [ ] **Quoins**: x 3 and 26 at y 13-14, 17-18, 21-22, cut_sandstone. Part: shell. Vocab: `quoins`.
elements.md:18:- [ ] **Three chimneys with smoke**: W x 1..2 z 9..10, C x 12..13 z 0..1, E x 27..28 z 9..10, y 6..32 bricks, trim band y 30, slab cap ring y 33 (stepping out 1), W and E: hay_block y 32 + lit signal campfire y 33 in one flue cell; C capped, no fire. Part: chimneys. Vocab: `chimney`.
elements.md:19:- [ ] **Back yards**: cobblestone paving x 3..26 z -5..1 y 6; brick walls y 7..8 coping slab y 9; dividing wall x 12; dark_oak_fence_gate at x 7 and 15, z -5; keeper doors x 7, 15 z 2; rear door x 23. Part: yard. Vocab: `yardWall`.
elements.md:20:- [ ] **Street**: road andesite y 5 z 23..28, polished_andesite kerb y 6 z 22, smooth_stone pavement y 6 z 19..21; lamp posts at pavement edge z 21 (x 0, 14, 29: dark_oak_fence + lantern, NOT x 4..20 z 19..20). Part: yard. Vocab: `lampPost`.
elements.md:21:- [ ] **Light**: all rooms >= 8; rear lanterns by keeper doors. Lamplighter after build.

input.summary:
parts/chimneys.mjs builds the three stacks (W, C, E) on their plan footings, y 6..33: brick shafts, smooth_sandstone band at y 30, 4x4 slab cap ring at y 33, and on W and E a hay_block signal base with a lit campfire (signal_fire true) at the top.
make.sh runs whole: chimneys placed 283, refused 0, off-palette none. mcd check shows no orphans or floating blocks at the chimney cells. Renders show C and W rising out of the mansard with band and cap, and the W campfire on top.
elements.md item "Three chimneys with smoke" is ticked. plan.md has no checkboxes.
left: The vocab chimney() flue is brick at y 31-32 with an enclosed air pocket below y 31, so the flue is not open. Smoke still rises from the campfire at y 33, but the 1x1 flue is not a through-draught. Left as the vocab's design; a flue-open option would fix it.
The campfire's signal_fire state is set by overwriting the helper's campfire cell in parts/chimneys.mjs, because vocab chimney() writes lit only. A helper fix would remove the override.
Smoke particles do not show in the static render; that is expected, not checked.
I did not add a Notes line to plan.md for these two points.

waste.what: Checked the chimney helper's flue and cap geometry by reading vocab/h1.mjs source, then probed build.nbt cell by cell with a throwaway script to confirm the C stack and the W campfire state.
waste.cost: about 3 tool calls and one probe script
waste.tool: A `mcd probe build.nbt x,y,z ...` command (or a `mcd cells`) that prints the block and state at given coordinates would replace the throwaway script.

waste.what: Overrode the helper's campfire cell to add signal_fire true, which chimney() does not write.
waste.cost: one extra g.set per fire stack
waste.tool: vocab chimney() option `{ signal: true }` or passing campfire state through, so the helper writes signal_fire itself.

waste.what: Checked the stacks by eye from elevations and zoom renders to confirm they rise out of the roof and that the campfire sits on top.
waste.tool: `mcd card --layout eye` or a `mcd zoom` pass over the roof-keep cells would be cheaper than eyeballing each stack.

companions.task: Check the 2x2 brick shaft and the flue detail, and decide whether the flue should be open to the top for a real draught instead of sealed by brick at y 31.
Check where the three stacks pass through the mansard keep and the roof's lead-in around them at y 24, so the roof stays whole around each stack.
